title: Architecture Decision Records
html:
Use this index to locate governing decisions without reading the full history. Each linked record owns its status, decision, rationale, and consequences. Acceptance does not imply implementation; see validation availability and the technology map.

For a new decision, read authoring policy, inspect related records, and use the proposed template. Current behavior belongs in the policy index, not in rewritten historical ADRs.
